{{Top|leg}}
The '''White Plague''', also named the "'''Weeping Pox'''" by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], was an illusory [[Disease/Legends|disease]] that was created by the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] and spread throughout the [[Almanian system]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]] in [[44 ABY]], after the arrival of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]]. As [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]], the Fallanassi succumbed to Abeloth's influence and were able to conjure the illusion by manipulating the [[White Current]], leading all beings who were not [[Force immersion|immersed]] in the Current to believe in the existence of the plague's symptoms on their bodies, which suffered from illusory rashes.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

The inhabitants of Pydyr were unable to find any cure or explanation regarding the plague, prompting them to quarantine the entire moon by restricting all outgoing traffic and warning all incoming traffic away. The White Plague also created an atmosphere of fear on Pydyr that Abeloth fed on in order to replenish her strength, with the terror of Pydyr's inhabitants being concentrated in a [[Magma/Legends|molten]] pit in the gathering hall of the hidden [[Fallanassi village]]. The illusions ceased upon Abeloth's [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|defeat]] and subsequent escape from Pydyr.<ref name="Vortex" />
